~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ fw42-ctxm FW context ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### VPN PREFIX START ########### 
!
changeto context NOVA22
config terminal
!
!
object-group network VRF_NOVA-TEST35_Subnets
  network-object 10.45.54.248 255.255.255.248
  network-object 10.45.55.112 255.255.255.240
!
access-list NOVA-TEST35_access_in extended permit ip 10.45.54.248 255.255.255.248 any
access-list NOVA-TEST35_access_in extended permit ip 10.45.55.112 255.255.255.240 any
!
route NOVA-TEST35 10.45.54.248 255.255.255.248 10.45.54.214 1
route NOVA-TEST35 10.45.55.112 255.255.255.240 10.45.54.214 1
!
! ########### VPN PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site01-hub42 FW context router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
ip route 10.45.54.248 255.255.255.248 10.45.54.25 name NOVA22:VPNX01-IBPOOL26-VGLUE=NOVA-TEST35
ip route 10.45.55.112 255.255.255.240 10.45.54.25 name NOVA22:VPNX01-IBPOOL26=NOVA-TEST35
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site02-hub42 FW context router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
ip route 10.45.54.248 255.255.255.248 10.45.54.25 name NOVA22:VPNX01-IBPOOL26-VGLUE=NOVA-TEST35
ip route 10.45.55.112 255.255.255.240 10.45.54.25 name NOVA22:VPNX01-IBPOOL26=NOVA-TEST35
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site01-hub1 VPN gateway router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### VRF START ########### 
!
ip vrf NOVA-TEST35
  rd 64000:321
  route-target export 64000:321
  route-target import 64000:321
!
router bgp 64000
  address-family ipv4 vrf NOVA-TEST35
    redistribute connected
    redistribute static
    no synchronization
        network 0.0.0.0
        exit-address-family
!
! ########### VRF END ############# 

! ########### VGLUE PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan 123
  name VPNX01-IBPOOL26-VGLUE=NOVA-TEST35
!
interface TenGigabitEthernet1/26
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 123
!
interface Port-channel1
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add 123
!
interface vlan123
  description VPNX01-IBPOOL26-VGLUE=NOVA-TEST35
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding NOVA-TEST35
  ip address 10.45.54.253 255.255.255.248
  standby ip 10.45.54.254
  standby preempt
  standby priority 105
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 ewhr324jflewfjosdfjof
  no shutdown
!
ip route vrf NOVA-TEST35 10.45.55.112 255.255.255.240 10.45.54.249 name NOVA22:VPNX01-IBPOOL26=NOVA-TEST35
!
! ########### VPN PREFIX END #############

!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ myvpn vpn gateway ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### VPN PREFIX START ########### 
config terminal
!
interface Ethernet1/8.123
  nameif IBPOOL26
  security-level 50
  ip address 10.45.54.249 255.255.255.248 standby 10.45.54.250
!
mtu IBPOOL26 1500
!
ip local pool IBPOOL26 10.45.55.113-10.45.55.125 mask 255.255.255.240
route IBPOOL26 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.45.54.254 26
!
group_policy 123 internal
group_policy 123 attributes
  split-tunnel-policy tunnelall
  vlan 123
  address-pools value IBPOOL26
exit
!
! ########### VPN PREFIX END #############
